title: Malibu Estate Price Swings: Carson’s former home jumps to $110m; sale history charts luxury surge
summary_full: Johnny Carson's iconic Malibu estate has embarked on quite a price adventure. Initially acquired for around nine point five million dollars, the property was later listed at eighty-one point five million dollars. It ultimately sold for forty million dollars in 2019 and has now returned to the market, boasting a staggering price tag of one hundred ten million dollars.
